name: Horde Trauma
summary: At Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands, Horde Trauma calls skilled medics into front-line surgery. Doctor Gregory Victor, chief physician of the Horde's trauma division, seeks hands able to save lives under extreme pressure.

sections.title: A Summons from Hammerfall
sections.body: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, the orc first aid trainer Arnok tells proficient healers that they have caught Doctor Gregory Victor's attention. Victor oversees Horde Trauma from Hammerfall, tucked away in the contested hills of the Arathi Highlands. Arnok regards the summons as the pinnacle of professional advancement for a battlefield surgeon.

sections.title: The Brutal Work of Battlefield Triage
sections.body: At Hammerfall, constant skirmishes with Stromgarde's forces and local hostile factions leave Victor inundated with wounded grunts, raiders, and scouts. The chief physician wastes no time welcoming recruits with pleasantries. Instead, he orders newcomers into their scrubs to prove their worth in brutal, fast-paced emergency triage.

faq.answer: Horde Trauma is the Horde's dedicated medical and surgical branch on the front lines. Doctor Gregory Victor leads it from Hammerfall, where its members specialize in battlefield medicine, emergency triage, and severe combat injuries under chaotic conditions.

faq.q: Who sends me on this assignment?
faq.answer: Arnok, the orc first aid trainer in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, issues the summons. He regards serving under Doctor Gregory Victor as the pinnacle of professional advancement for an aspiring field medic.

faq.q: Where is Doctor Gregory Victor located?
faq.answer: Doctor Gregory Victor is stationed in the medical infirmary at Hammerfall in the northeastern Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Hammerfall?
faq.answer: When you arrive, Doctor Victor immediately tells you to don your scrubs for the follow-up assignment, Triage. You are tested under high stress as you prioritize and treat wounded soldiers whose condition is rapidly worsening, before they succumb to their injuries.

faq.q: Why is Hammerfall so desperate for field medics?
faq.answer: Hammerfall is surrounded by hostilities in Arathi and faces relentless conflict with human forces, syndicate operatives, and local beasts. Casualties stream into the encampment constantly, pressing its small medical staff to the limit.

faq.q: Can Alliance players take this assignment?
faq.answer: No. Horde Trauma is for members of the Horde. The Alliance has an equivalent medical evaluation led by Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen at Theramore Isle.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you depend on rugged battlefield surgeons to keep grunts patched up and swinging in brutal frontier conflicts like the Arathi Highlands.
As a priest, you can seal wounds with divine magic, but secular triage teaches you to judge who can be saved when your mana runs dry.
